Refreshing Hope. Our lives are filled with hope. I have found more with tai chi/Yoga-Go thank you. If you’re unable to do exercises from younger days and even with limited movement try this. I am happier and more content than I have been for years.

Chair Yoga!. I have Sciatica, which inhibits me standing for more than 4 minutes. I thought I’d signed up for weight loss yoga, however strength and flexibility popped up and I LOVE IT. The sequences are possible for me to do without aggravating my condition. They lift my spirit and have reminded me I can still move. And the standing poses are short enough for me to do. I try to do my chair yoga before breakfast, but get to the kitchen where someone is cooking something that smells good. We have had guests for a few weeks now. Nieces, friends, and my son and his young family. Schedules have been changing, but I hope to prioritize CHAIR YOGA now that it’s just my husband and I home.
Love the simplicity of the lessons. Love this!!

Yoga go tai chi for women. The experience was highly disappointing. They say it’s a workout made by women for women and I ended up having videos of this male trainer that did not represent what I’m looking for. They market this product using the image of mature women who look fit and toned, but I received videos with a male trainer who, with all due respect, does not look fit and toned. So, which one is it? Can Tai Chi make your body fit and toned or not? Is not a good image to represent what they’re marketing. They use mature fit and toned women in the ads and the one who appeared to be “the face” of the product, is not in the videos. If you’re marketing a product with an image, that’s what you’re selling. You’re selling the image of a toned, fit mature female body that was reached by doing tai chi exercises. They promise quick changes in the ads, so awesome, that you should be “turning heads” by the 28th day. So, why did I get videos of this training “made by women for women” with a male trainer with a chubby appearance? I’m sorry for saying that, but it’s true. My goal is for real an I really needed what they marketed, but it was highly disappointing. Not only that, but if you are not satisfied by the end of the month, they say you may request a refund. But, for my surprise, the catch was that I had to prove the I tried the program, which is highly tricky. I asked how I could prove that and they responded by sending snapshots and stuff like that, but it didn’t seem trustworthy. However, I do want to point out that after sending out all my complaints, I requested a refund and they refunded my money.

Worst customer service ever!!!! Don’t sign up!!!. Calming and stretching. I saw this on social media and was very hesitant but for a nominal fee I was able to start. I had been very active and then a foot injury had prevented me from doing much. What started as something I was going to do for a month has lasted for over a year. I find the exercises to perfect to do before bedtime. They stretch you out, they build strength and the voice of the narrator has the most calming effect on me. I have introduced other people to it, and everyone feels the same way. It’s short enough that it’s not overwhelming, it’s more challenging as it continues so that you actually build strength: it adds flexibility and it gives me a sense of accomplishment at the end of the day. I have recommended this too many people.

Great Experience. I am finding the Yoga- Go excellent and easy to follow.
I am sleeping better and am pain free!
Started. But only did 4 days. Since it was a 28 day program I thought I could do at my own pace. I was wrong. Can’t continue. It was a new subscription payment.
Great App. Love this app… so relaxing… fits my particular level of exercise…

Excellent customer service. I highly recommend Yoga-Go if you’re looking for highly excellent customer service. I appreciate the time the team took to answer all my concerns-they went above and beyond my expectations. It’s hard to find companies like this anymore. I cannot thank them enough.

I am leanring about chi in a way I never have and also benefiting on all levels from the teachings.

Yoga-Go, traditional yoga. Two and a half years ago, at age 65, I saw this program on social media and decided to start an exercise routine. I had been basically sedentary and wanted to tone and strengthen my body, and lose belly fat. I tried all of the different methods that were offered, and preferred traditional yoga. I spent a year doing beginning yoga, a couple of months doing intermediate, then moved to advanced yoga. 
I try to do yoga every day, even when traveling, and on vacation. I love that I only need a yoga mat and my phone or iPad, I can schedule my workout to meet my needs, and I can do my workouts in privacy. I also enjoy the flexibility of choosing between 7-minute workouts, flat-belly workouts, or my longer traditional yoga sessions. I have recommended this program to many friends and family due to its flexibility and my satisfaction. I feel strong and confident, and I’ve lost about 40 pounds and four dress sizes!

Incompetence. Their claim was they could not find my email: the one associated with my account. Then, the request was made to send screenshots of all this other stuff: purchase receipts, account details, etc. Is this really where we are-instead of doing their jobs at a basic level of competence, the consumer is asked to do all these things FOR them? What are we doing here? This is the digital age, right? Perhaps it’s time, we, as a world, return to analog living. At least in part. Teach problem solving. Resolution. Basic searching.

My best advice: Take your business elsewhere.

I’ve been doing yoga for years and since a knee injury chair yoga had great appeal. My knee has improved so I now combine both methods. 
Thank you for giving me the opportunity to ask my increase level question and to let you know how much I look forward to my morning Yoga go program.

I have a problem raising my legs above to the wall. I’m 79. I love placing legs forward, spreading to sides & especially the floor bicycle positions. I’m so glad I’m in the habit of doing this.

What’s going on?. I was enjoying this app and doing tai chi most days. When I finished the first series of 28 days I was offered to do something completely different or to start the same series again. I decided to do that because to learn the forms you have to repeat often, even though I found it annoying to have to repeat the beginning days which are short and very basic. Now suddenly it’s all different. The AI teacher is gone and there is a real man teaching. It’s completely different. The practices are much shorter than what it says they will be. It feels like it’s suddenly made up on the spot. No consistency here. A slow and steady introduction of forms with lots of repetition should be the format. And follow up series should be different, but build on what was learnt before. Also I realized that I paid $15.19 the first month, and then suddenly I got charged $38.95 for consecutive months while I didn’t receive anything different. I’d like them to get their act together, because the idea of this is great and I was enjoying it.

Better health. I have suffered my whole life in pain. I have gone to a chiropractor every week for around 15 years to manage that pain.
Last year I had cancer, and was concerned for my health and longevity.
I began this program 2 weeks ago. Some days I can do the yoga in the morning and tai chi at night. Some days I choose the stretching along since my work is so laborious.

My doctors said my numbers have improved significantly. I was tested for cancer prior to the classes then this week!

My chiropractor said there was barely anything out of alignment. Other than being tired from my day to day work, all my doctors say I am healthier than I ever have been! It has to be this app because I didn’t change my diet and I still work at my labor intensive job.
Thank you! I especially love the tai chi for longevity class. The yoga is very great too!

The instructor’s voice and demeanor is very calming. It is a perfect way to start the day before heading off to work and to just get a little self-care time in.

However, I got the app and paid for three months of exercises based on wanting to get more toned and in shape, which several Instagram ads talked about and convinced me it would help with. Those ads also said the daily practice that would be designed for me was only seven minutes. While the exercises are very calming and may create some tone in my arms, overall, there is no way they could possibly deliver what’s promised. The workouts start at about 12 minutes a day and some days they are as many as 23 minutes, so definitely a different length than mentioned. Also almost half the workout ends up being meditation. Again, this has its place and is very helpful in some ways, but it is not why I purchased it. Personally, I also find the voice-over repetitive, unhelpful overtime, and grating. Great Tai Chi Class - Wish For A Second 28-Day Class. We really enjoyed this wonderful Beginner Tai Chi 28-Day Class. Now I’m looking for a Second 28-Day Class! This was better than anything I have found!
Rejuvenation. It has only been 5 days and I am sleep and feel better than I have in the past six years. Thank you

Bilateral Demonstrations. It would be so much easier to learn the left and right combinations if the model performed them with her back to the camera. I find it very difficult to watch her doing things the opposite from the opposite perspective of what she’s saying.

Great workout. The Wall Pilates for beginners is slow paced but just like any other exercise if you’ve been out of the loop for a while it will make you feel like you’ve been out of the loop. Lol, I was sore after day three but kept going and worked it out. I suggest it for you, and wish you all the best!

Best yoga app!!. I absolutely love this app. I started using it about 2 years ago and had ZERO yoga experience but wanted to learn. The way my body has been transformed is amazing. I’m more limber and flexible at age 49 than I was at 20! Poses that I used to think impossible I now do with ease. I use the app almost daily. Love everything about it. Best fitness choice I’ve ever made :)
Tai chi. I’m really enjoying the Tai Chi for beginners that I am doing. It’s only been a week and I feel so much better.

So Far So Good. I’m enjoying the short yoga sessions and find them so easy to incorporate into my life. I love when I travel that I am able to do the yoga sessions in my hotel room. At home, I can usually squeeze one session into even the busiest days.

Thoughts on Tai Chi. I’m enjoying the Tai Chi movements and breathing and I try to go through the steps everyday. Sometimes I have to skip. I have one suggestion. The hand movements are sometimes confusing to me. I think if the leader could turn around so I could see them from the back, it would help. Even though I don’t always do the moves right, it’s been fun to try and I’m learning to control my breathing. On the days I use the app, I’m almost positive my energy level is greater than when I don’t. Thank you.

Amp it Up. I’ve enjoyed the Yoga-Go Chair Yoga. It’s helped me tone my body over the past 3 months. The only issue I have is that the degree of difficulty starts over each month so it’s like going back to step 1 every 30 days and building back to the harder workouts. I would really like to continue progressing and increasing the difficulty every month.
Tai chi. This program is great - especially for beginners like me. I candle fi all the moves yet but I will!
Spinal stenosis and scoliosis. Right side leg won’t lift. I’m hope this helps my flexibility,. This should help me but need to practice. The man was very good.
Beginner Tai Chi. Fantastic initial immersion in to this healing art.
They trick you. I have been trying to cancel for months! They don’t make it easy! Dishonesty is apparently their policy
Crooked. I cancelled my intro subscription and got rid of the app. Now I got charged $66.65, which they say is for 3 months!!!! They are bogus and dishonest!!!

Awesome effect!. I have been taking this class for 2 weeks . I already feel the benefits in my body. I am able to sleep better and I am more relaxed and energetic than before. I wish I could have done this before!!!

Love this Tai Chi app. I love the approach teaching Tai Chi. It doesnt overwhelm with lots of new things in each session. It builds slowly, lets u repeat if you need too, gives clear images and instructions. I can learn at my pace. And the app helps me stay disciplined and engaged.
Great. I like the fact that I can pick an exercise that is my level. I’ve had several back surgeries and knee surgeries due to motor vehicle accident and it really is very good.

This App is AMAZING. I am 46 years old. I found this app and I wasn’t sure about it at first, but once I started and saw how. Easy it was for me to learn and strengthen my body. I broke my back a few years ago, so this is absolutely wonderful for any back injuries or health issues you were able to do this. You can do any stage easy moderate hard you can set it to a timer you can do other training not just the once a day training, I would definitely recommend this to everyone I know, and I do it every morning before my daughter goes to school and I’m done for the day. It really is great.
Expensive. I got charged $15 the first month with $1.25 foreign tax fee and the next month I got charged $39
Morning yoga. I try and do yoga every morning Plus wall Pilates. Seems to help me stay limber throughout the day. I’m 72 with some back issues so it seems the stretching helps.

Yoga-Go keeps me feeling good. I’m a 75 yo male, who uses Yoga-Go on a regular basis. I’ve completed Tai Chi, Pilates (wall & chair), core strength and various yoga series.

Yoga-Go keeps me moving!
I can’t believe the difference.. After four days of doing tai chi, my balance has improved immensely. I am actually sleeping better at night also.

My Tai Chi Experience. I am retired, 69 years old and trying to learn something new. This should be good for me. 
I have been rather sedate since I retired.
I have been trying to figure out what I can do to help myself get back into shape with all my arthritis and other assorted issues. 
I thought Tai Chi might be the way to go. 
I am happy to say that I am doing alright. The lessons are a little overwhelming at times, but when I find it difficult to do the movements I just keep trying. Right now I am not the best, but one day I will be every bit as graceful as the teacher. I can tell you that since I started my Tai Chi training, I am sleeping much better and I find that I think about my posture more and I believe that it’s a very good thing for me to have chosen at this age.
Every Morning. I use Yoga-Go every morning to get my day started off. The stretching is essential to me to start the day, plus it gives me a peaceful mindset, which is so important.

Would be nice to try for even 2-3 days to see if you want to pay for it.. Gets good reviews and seems to have good support but I’m not going to just pay $20-60 for something I don’t know anything about. I understand it’s foolish to give away more than just a few days to a week but how can you know you want to subscribe without even opening it?
Won’t open. Won’t open after paying
Mind, body balance:Tai chi. Tai chi yoga is superb the movements are gentle and powerful,living me relaxed and energetic
Buyer Beware. They will charge you for ongoing membership when you did not sign up for that! Be safe and stay aware. Plus, according to Instagram, this account is located in the Ukraine!?!?
Subscription. After only 6 days after my subscription for 30 days beginners of Tai Chi I cannot have access to the video. They are pushing to buy another subscription. I really want to cancel it.

Enjoying it!. I didn’t know what to expect but it has been more than great. It’s different than anything I have ever tried. The routines change enough to keep it interesting. I am so glad I signed up.

Awareness. Helps to reduce anxiety and promotes calmness 🙂 TY

Practical app that makes my yoga practice more consistent. I’ve been using this app for the past few years and it has been instrumental in keeping my interest and helping me consistently meet my fitness goals.
Keeps me moving. I have used many of the routines and feel that I benefit from the movements and strength building they provide

Watching on tv is super glitchy. I like the workouts on this app, but i’m super frustrated with how glitchy it is when you try to watch it on your TV. reviews.text: Fun and Motivating. This program delivers. The choices of tai chi, yoga, or pilates provide a nice variety. The ability to adjust the level of your activity every day by indicating if the session was too easy, too hard or perfect really personalizes the experience.
Expanding My Flexibility. One week in and I am enjoying the course given to this 71 year old body. Really easy so far, as some of the stepping moves take a bit to master.
Chair yoga. Good for flexibility
Clear, concise movements!. Excellent video showing Tia Chi movements. Perfect timing and movement with just the right amount of time while being a very new beginner.

The best exercise platform I’ve used.. I’ve always been a physical, active and strong person, but as I got older injuries have challenged me to do even the simplest things. Yoga Go allows me to customize my exercises while still getting the benefits of a workout. It’s very smart!
Connection. I can not conéctate to my tv!
Improving. The pace is perfect for me. Thank you for helping those of us who signed up to improve and sustain our health
User. Love this app
Relaxation. I have enjoyed doing my early morning workout. It is so relaxing. As I listen to the narration, I envision peace, joy and cleansing going through my body. I love it !
So relaxing. I love the beginners pace. I feel confident that I will indeed complete this course and maybe even remember a few moves.

Wonderful app!. I look forward to practicing Qui Gong and Tai Chi daily, and this app is exceptional, with clear direction and an instructor with a calm, soothing voice. You are able to create your level of engagement and I’m so glad I discovered this!

I like the app ok. The movements in the first few days were nice and I enjoyed them. 
I was unfamiliar with the terms and meaning behind the terms of “Dantien,” “Chi,” and “ Condensing Qu.” Once I looked them up and discovered the meanings, I think this exercise method is not for me. As a Christ Follower, I believe this is a spiritual practice that will not work for my belief. 
Thank you for asking my opinion. 
Best wishes…

It’s worked 4 me. I started in June 2025 and it’s been a great help for my health.. I have arthritis in both of my knees and had not been doing much walking or exercising since the beginning of the pandemic.. was sent home to work which made me less mobile as I sat all day and went out very little .. I started with my bones cracking like Rice Krispies lots of snap crackle and pops !! Which has now become less noisy ! Im able to walk more and ive managed to lose weight with yoga and better food choices ! Im newly 50 .. I’ve gone from 310 to 240 with another 25 lb weight loss goal ! I love this app but I’ve set to 25-30 minutes and it’s always just 25 minutes ! It would be nice to be able to pick my favorites for a session of favorites !! All in all I think it’s worth getting the app and sticking with it !

Gets me moving, but …. Much of the exercises are good stretches, which I need at age 71. The variety of choices leaves something to be desired. I am not menopausal (male here), not interested in meditation/relaxation sessions, do not need stress relief, not interested in ‘body awareness’ with somatic yoga. All of which leave me with rather limited choices in sessions. Finally, the practice sessions are ALWAYS 40 minutes long. I have repeatedly provided feedback that the sessions are either too long or too difficult (sometimes both), yet there is not change in the sessions. Evidently, no one is reading the feedback to provide any course correction! Overall - 3 out of 10 rating. Not sure I will be renewing.

Challenging but good. I've been using the app almost daily. It's improved my muscle tone, balance and is relatively easy to follow. There is one move- the rollover which is impossible for someone my age. I wish there were alternatives given. I don't want to lose what I've gained by switching to another app.

Very managable. At 75 and never done yoga before. My flexibility isn't what it used to be, but after about 6 weeks of chair yoga for beginners I can see a noticeable difference. My sessions are between 10 and 20 minutes and I'm almost to the point of enjoying them.

Hurt my foot. Tried to sign up for the walking program but was given a more difficult task and it hurt the bones in my foot by trying to balance on one foot. I do not plan to use it at all 
Would like a refund
Great App. Easy to use and great Tai Chi sessions !

I Subscribed for Tai Chi. I did not subscribe for chair yoga or Pilates! I wanted to try Tai Chi because I hadn’t done it before. The sessions are too long. I wanted no more than 15 minutes. Most of the instructions are clear but I find the one with the “ball of chi” and instructions for arm movements to be confusing. There seems to be no other reference to the teaching of this movement. For this reason I have consistently rated the practice too hard.

First start. Nice and slow. Helps me get in touch with my body and concentrate on my mind’s response to breathing through the exercise. I’ve had foot surgery and moved on to PT. Robin V.

79 and counting. The app I have is perfect for me. It keeps my arthritic joints loose, my range of motion good, and my core stronger. I feel my best when I use it daily. My problem is I have to do it early otherwise I forget ☺️. Don’t change a thing for me. I will get there in being consistent because I know it’s what I need. Thank you.
Very good app!. Many activities are included beyond yoga. I joined for the Yoga to assist with my core, balance, and to use as a run warm up. As a senior this app provides a lot of physical benefit!
Glad to be back. I'm getting back into the chair yoga after some medical problems and I'm so glad! It's a little bit of my time! I feel better afterwards and a little bit of peace as well.

Free is not Free. This app claims to be free, and offers “in app purchases”. In reality, it is a recurring litany of fees and “renewal” charges plus you cannot simply unsubscribe. Love it. I’m gonna tell you I purchased this app by mistake. I thought it was a calisthenics but I gave it a shot going on three years now and I love it. It’s easy it’s quick. They put a plan work out plantogether for you and it’s just flat out phenomenal

Good Work out. My workout plan is a great way to start my day, from my PJs, then on to the rest of my routine. I especially love the ability to get my heart rate up during cold days when I can’t get outside.

Great starter & ongoing. Have used same 12-13 min series for several months. As I got stronger I just added additional abs & arm band sessions. I've added walking on the treadmill too. I have chronic lung condition and have found this program a great way to build strength & endurance. 

I am only disappointed in how the price of the app continues to increase. It started at $28 annual, then went to quarterly, now it's double that quarterly. I'm figuring to cancel at the end of this quarter.
BEWARE. This company has a horrible satisfaction/refund policy. I would not recommend this app to anyone for any reason.

Scam. This app is a scam! There is no customer number to call to cancel. The contact us page is a fluke!! U cant click on anything to reach out to anyone. They charged my card twice this month and i dont even have an account with. They automatically charged my card even though i declined the subscription. Now i have to deal with my bank to close the card out!! Do not purchase!!!

Simple workout to get the blood moving. Yoga Go has improved dramatically over the past two years. Instruction is clear and timing is good. In the past the voice and movements were not in sync. If you are not flexible you can feel a little sore after the basic stretches. It would help if there were alternatives or acknowledgements for not being able to do some stretches.

Yoga Go keeps me healthy every day!. I sit in front of the desk all day. I used to have ache and pain from time to time. Since I do Yoga Go everyday, I feel so good. Yoga Go is effective to get rid off all my aches and pains. I love Yoga Go! It is gentle and meets for my daily stretching needs.

Overcharges. I cancelled my subscription and got an email confirming it was cancelled. I was charged again and when I asked for a refund, they denied it saying it was just now cancelled not 3 months earlier when I originally cancelled.

recent changes. i have been using you go for over two years and i find it in the whole very useful. recently, the exercises have been started to repeat during the same session. also i can no longer opt for a time limit for my personalized plan. this wouldn’t be an issue if the pre-assigned time limit were longer than 5 minutes. both of these things have led me to lower my rating for this app.

Steady & Effective. I appreciate the variety of the daily videos, and done consistently, they work! I never thought that Yoga would help my flexibility and reduce my neck and shoulder discomfort, but tried it at the recommendation of my chiropractor. I chose this program because it looked appropriate for someone of my age who was new to yoga. The instructions are clear, and they listen to your feedback, increasing or decreasing the intensity of the program as needed.

New droid Yoga.. I’m doing yoga for the very first time….
I liked the filling of relaxation after the practice …. Looking forward for more!

Yoga Go Has Changed My Life. I started Yoga Go going on 2 years this January. I am 67 and have Chronic Fatigue Syndrome, Inflammatory Arthritis, Fibromyalgia and too many other diagnoses to put here. Even though I had 3 surgeries the first year, and wasn’t able to do Yoga everyday because of recovery restrictions, Yoga Go definitely impacted my recovery. Walking around the house was exhausting and it was difficult to breathe. I was able to go to a concert last week and I was able to dance for the first time in decades! 50 minutes! I am slowly losing weight and am learning how to play the piano and Spanish. I am volunteering and socializing. I believe that Yoga Go has been a major part of getting my life back.

JB yoga plan. Data is incorrect and needs to be changed however there is no way to adjust info. Terrible.

It really works. I was skeptical I needed to tone up ,lose some weight. I didn’t think 10 to 15 minutes in a chair each day was really going to help , but I needed some motivation something to try so I tried this and it worked within a month! I could feel my muscles tightening and my body toning , and my clothes fit better. I’m so happy I gave it a shot and will continue to keep it in my daily routine!

Never felt stronger at 58!. I started using Yoga-go over a year ago. I now do three routines every other day. The Hard-level Wall Pilates, abs/core Pilates or weight loss Pilates, and then chair yoga for cool down. I’m addicted, mainly because I can see a huge improvement in my flexibility, muscle tone, and overall strength. Plus, coupling my routines with GLP-1 and protein diet, I’ve lost 74.7lbs. I am honestly in my best shape ever at 58! Thank you Yoga-Go, I’m a lifetime subscriber!
Predatory charging. Predatory charging
Perfect for someone out of shape!!!!. Love yoga-go. It’s a great basic workout that escalates your challenge with time!

Enjoying my workout. I’m very pleased with the Yoga-Go app. There is no wasteful lead in talking. When I do chair yoga in the morning it is like meditation and I get in touch with my body. Such a perfect way to start the day. The Flat Belly and 7 Minute Workout are perfect follow ups and do a great job improving my balance and strength. customer service exceptional!!. i had an issue with my account and it was handled superbly! super fast! i am happy!!!

Cancel. Please discontinue this app ASAP

Tai Chi. I’m enjoying the exercises except the coach at times gives the instructions too rapidly to follow.

Tai Chi and Yoga. This app has been great and has helped me get back to exercising. The sessions are short enough to keep me motivated and perfect for a beginner
Easy tai chi for seniors. So far, so good, I’ve only done nine episodes, it is just enough, not too much, not too little.

Great app for my husband and I. My husband and I have been doing this together. We’re doing the Pilates wall workout. We are finding it challenging. We feel like it’s making us stronger and also more flexible. As we age, strength and flexibility are qualities we are prioritizing. We hope to continue with other modalities when we finish this one!

Martin. Very good app and great options for daily practice. One area of improvement is to have verbal instructions both sync with the on screen action better and also to provide constant verbal instruction because most of the time you are not able to watch the screen the whole time.

Confused. I really enjoy the workouts although they need to be a little more versatile. When I finished the last session, it asked if I wanted to increase the intensity, I said yes and it just sat there upgrading for more than an hour until I got frustrated and turned it off. I closed the app and went back to it and nothing changed.

Feel Good Yoga. I got this app for the chair yoga, as I have knee replacement, and also now recovering from arm fractures. Getting on the floor is near impossible as well as getting back up. 60 year old male. Yoga-Go chair yoga is a terrific, fun, and habit forming program to get in shape and stay in shape. Going on into my third year now , and it’s been fun and has helped me to build strength, flexibility, lose weight, and has decreased my pain and improved my sense of well being.

Love It. A great way to increase flexibility every morning.

reviews.text: Wall Pilates. I’m an early riser. I enjoy the wall Pilates every morning. Great pace, beginner friendly, convenient time choice, excellent breathing technique. I love it!

Great workout app!. I bought a subscription to this app to get back into shape after having developed a gut. I really don’t enjoy working out in front of others, so I’ve avoided getting a gym membership. This app has great workouts that are easy to follow on my own and the yearly subscription seems like a great value. Less than $5 per month.
Update: After using the app every day religiously for nine months, I really feel like it has help me to be healthier and more grounded. I use the yoga routines every morning as a warmup for more vigorous workouts like calisthenics or weight training.
Not worth your money. If you have any yoga experience at all this is a complete waste of your money. Very basic sequences and no way to get to more intermediate or advanced modules that I can find.

Not really for beginners. I bought this app to learn tai chi. I am a beginner. It was going well until day four, when suddenly they introduced complex movements without breaking the movements down step-by-step. I was unable to progress from that point. I reached out to customer service. They do not seem to be aware of the problem where the videos are showing complex movements, but not teaching how to do them. In the end, I asked for a refund which day said they are processing.

Long lasting results. I’m 70 years old and have done the 25 minute hard chair yoga daily for 600+ sessions. It’s part of my daily routine in the morning like brushing my teeth!
I love the way that the sessions are daily varied so that I have to stay focused, but now I know how to perform each exercise and I’m able to concentrate on intensity. I was on Ozempic for about 6 months and lost most of my muscle strength because of it. Got off of the medicine and now my muscles are beautifully toned and strong.

Flow duration. Classic yoga. When I first began the classic yoga the duration began at 7 minutes even though I put 25-30 minutes as my preference. I thought it was just because I began a new plan. But, after completing the first 30 days and I began the second 30 days the plan began back at 7- 8 minutes. Which is discouraging since now I’m beginning day 61 and it reverts back to 7 minutes. I wish it would just start where I left off at 30 minutes. The flow is sometimes really choppy. Taking an extra movement to table top from downward facing dog to move into warrior 1. And sometimes at the end she says find a comfortable seated position for savanna and then moves into another posture.

Yoga-Go. I’m really enjoying this app! I really don’t like doing exercise however being 72 years old I need to work on my strength and balance etc. it’s a good app.
Thanks!

Chair Yoga with John has helped me. Love Chair Yoga with John. He keeps me moving, sometimes I like to do different exercises, but some of the same ones are ok too. Tried to do a different one and didn’t like it. I try to do it at least 3 tines a week.

Scoliosis and stretching. I am 65 and have severe scoliosis. Swimming is my best form of exercise and movement but getting to an accessible pool has been a challenge. This yoga program is gentle enough yet challenging my beliefs about how much my back will move. In the few days that I have used this program my morning stiffness has improved, my pain level has improved and I have hope again for an active life within my differently abled limits. Thank you.

Good to get going. This workout series does help with strength, if you get yourself going. Easy to join, just 10-15 minutes a day, and more workouts available. For me, it did not move the scale for weight loss. But I do feel much stronger. The AI instructor is fine, but some of the transitions don’t work, i.e. how much time to get on the floor or getting up, or explaining the moves. I’d still recommend it.
Thankyou !. Thankyou!
Yes I can.. Even though I am 76 years old, I am able to do all the poses so far. I am glad I can. I have done one every day. Look forward to more lessons

Mental and Physical Enhancement. Only 8 days in but anticipate staying with Yoga-Go indefinitely for Tai Chi. Could not be more pleased. Start every day with Yoga-Go. Feeling mental and physical improvement.

Newbie with lots of severe arthritis. Chair yoga was recommended by my rheumatologist with cautionary comments. The first series went well. Now that I am on my third month there are two some things I just can’t do because of pain. I wish I could have stayed a lower level longer.

Can’t cancel this app!!. I tried to cancel after the trial but I continue to be charged I need a refund! No way to quit this! update : I have tried so many times to cancel this app and they continue to charge me $38 a month. What a scam! I had to cancel my credit card. They have been charging me for months and I never used to app just tried to cancel right away before end of trial. Terrible terrible service!

Daily User. I have some balance issues and arthritic shoulder joints so Chair Yoga suits me very well. My friend comes over each morning and we have a half hour yoga session which I cast to my TV. I do have some suggestions - could the chair yoga be longer than 25 minutes -if there currently a way to make it longer?
